name: scene-open
title: Scene / Open
description: Open scene from the project asset file. Use 'assets-find' tool to find the scene asset first.

commonMistakes: Parameter is sceneRef (AssetObjectRef object), NOT scenePath (string)
notes: scene-open 属于场景受保护命令；若已有其它 AI 在做场景端到端，占用冲突时可通过 bridgeSceneLockMode=fail 立即放弃
若当前打开场景栈可能存在生成场景 dirty，调用时必须显式传 bridgeSceneDirtyPolicy；常见值是 discard-generated 或 save-generated
